title: Handling a valuable that might be a trap
target: How to handle a valuable in R.E.P.O. when it turns out to be a trap, using the behaviour the game gives those objects instead of assuming every pickup is quiet.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A valuable you have not handled before
A crew that knows where you are heading next

steps.do: Treat an unfamiliar valuable as something that may do something.
steps.because: the game has valuables built on a trap behaviour (Trap)

steps.do: Do not linger next to one once you have picked it up.
steps.because: a trap valuable can be set to start on a timer (triggerOnTimer)

steps.do: Expect monsters to take an interest in these objects.
steps.because: they carry an interest flag for monsters (enemyInvestigate)

steps.do: Put it down somewhere harmless if it starts moving, and come back for it.
steps.because: some of them move under their own turning force (SelfTorqueMultiplier)

steps.do: Use a valuable box when you want one contained rather than carried loose.
steps.because: a valuable box holds them with a value limit and an extraction time (ItemValuableBox)

commonMistakes: Assuming every valuable is a quiet pickup.
Standing over one while it does whatever it does.
Carrying a shaking object through a doorway.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
